answer: Proof of stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a crystal clear barrier against identity forgery. An attacker must bridge the canyon of prohibitive costs to acquire sufficient native tokens, as the marginal cost of creating new nodes is tethered to the jade market value of the underlying asset. Without proof of ownership, an agent cannot validate blocks or gain influence, rendering the spamming of fake identities economically irrational and technically futile.
